# Seaforth Heating & Cooling

> Seaforth Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Seaforth, Perth/Huron, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.
